rules.D_NULL: Part d. Null: 48 random head sets per model with exactly the six top SSDC heads' block counts (heads drawn uniformly within each block, the top-6 set itself excluded; seed fixed). Cost = top-1 points lost against the 0-5 window (classifiers) and SSDC lost entering block 11 against Cref (all four). HOLDS if the top-6 cost exceeds all 48 sets; HOLDS AT 95% if it exceeds at least 46; DOES NOT HOLD otherwise.
rules.D_WITHIN: Part d, from RB-0 (no new forward passes): Spearman of single-head SSDC cost vs top-1 cost computed within each of blocks 6-10 and averaged; p from a permutation that shuffles top-1 costs within blocks.
rules.AXIS: Axis test (parts a, b, c): retention = (arm - floor) / (intact - floor) of the row and column probes at the axis readout. AXES SEPARATE if removing the row planes in every block leaves row retention <= 0.1 and column retention >= 0.5, and removing the column planes does the converse; PARTLY otherwise if the removed axis always falls more than the other; NOT SEPARATE if not.
rules.REBUILD: Rebuild (parts a, b, c): normalised SSDC entering the last block after the first-half window (0: floor, 1: intact). REBUILDS if >= 0.5 (ViT-B at 224: 0.50-0.71); REBUILDS LESS if 0.2-0.5; DOES NOT REBUILD below 0.2.
rules.HEADS: Single heads (parts a, b): every head after the window, rotations off while the rest recover. SSDC rank = RB-2's rule (blocks before the last: SSDC lost entering the last block; last block: at FINAL); top-1 cost on 5,000 images with paired SE. Axis map (RB-2's windows and noise bar) for the union of the top 5 by top-1 and the top 5 by SSDC (part a adds the two costliest heads at 224).
rules.A_KEEPS: Part a: the head Section 4.5 names ((6,6), (6,9), (7,4)) KEEPS ITS RANK if it is among the 3 costliest single heads by top-1 at 320, and KEEPS ITS AXIS if its RB-2 label at 320 equals its label at 224.
rules.B_HEADS: Part b: top SSDC head and costliest top-1 head; whether each sits in the first two blocks after the window (12-13); share of the summed positive top-1 cost in blocks 12-13; Spearman of SSDC vs top-1 cost over all 192 heads; how many mapped heads favour one axis.
rules.E1: Part e (NpkG Q2): mean attention distance along rows |dr| and along columns |dc| (patches), blocks 1-4, head-averaged, 64 natural images. WIDER POOLING SUPPORTED if removing an axis's planes widens attention along that axis in at least 7 of the 8 (model, axis) cases and the widening rank-correlates (Spearman > 0.5, descriptive) with the rise of the other axis's probe above intact at block 4 (W5); NOT SUPPORTED if it widens in at most 4 of 8; MIXED otherwise.
rules.E2: Part e (RxJ2 Q3): hybrid, blocks 4-11, head-averaged distance and entropy. ROTATIONS KEEP LATE ATTENTION LOCAL if removing the rotations raises the mean distance in at least 6 of the 8 blocks and by at least 0.25 patches on average, while removing the embedding changes it by less than half as much; otherwise NOT SHOWN.
rules.C_START: Part c: STARTS NEAR ZERO if SSDC entering block 0 is at most 0.05 (Figure 2's RoPE pattern: ViT-B RoPE models 0.027-0.028, APE models 0.42-0.57), i.e. spatial structure is built by attention, not supplied by an embedding.
